name: Periglacial-Mastaba
description: An ocean of dust without banks. At the edge of sight, past impact-scarred wastelands, mirage-cities rise and collapse by noon, and the light turns brutal and white.

Thin air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything. Sampler drones return with spore-forming microbes that survive direct exposure to open sky.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
Whoever controls silicon controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
